results.title: Ask HN: How are you doing RAG locally?
results.content: Thread on local retrieval setups. Many run sqlite-vec or LanceDB; several complain that indexing a few thousand notes with a browser embedding model takes minutes and blocks the UI.

results.title: Smart Connections: local embedding model makes Obsidian unresponsive while indexing
results.content: Users with 4k+ note vaults report Obsidian freezing for several minutes when the local embedding model runs. Workarounds: exclude folders, switch to an API model, or index overnight.

results.title: Why our voice agent's RAG step was eating 40% of the latency budget
results.content: Breaking down a 800 ms turn: STT 180 ms, LLM first token 260 ms, retrieval 140-320 ms because every lookup is a network hop to a hosted vector DB. Moving retrieval in-process cut p95 by 210 ms.

results.title: Running embeddings in the browser with WebAssembly: a practical guide
results.content: Transformers.js with a quantized MiniLM runs at ~25 ms per sentence on a laptop in WASM SIMD; WebGPU helps on Chrome but Safari support is patchy. Index size and cold load dominate for large corpora.

results.title: Local-first software: semantic search without a server
results.content: Local-first apps need search that works offline and syncs. Options: SQLite FTS5 for keywords, sqlite-vec or hnswlib-wasm for vectors. Embedding generation on-device is the bottleneck on mobile.

results.title: pgvector vs in-process vector search for latency-sensitive agents
results.content: Benchmarks a pgvector HNSW index over a private link against an in-process index: 18 ms vs 1.2 ms p50, 85 ms vs 4 ms p99 under load. For voice, tail latency matters more than recall@10.

results.title: Edge functions and embedding models: cold starts hurt
results.content: Loading a 23 MB embedding model in an edge function adds 400-900 ms on cold start. Teams cache the model in a global or precompute embeddings at build time.

results.title: Show HN: semlocal - local semantic search for your notes, no vector DB
results.content: Open-source CLI that indexes markdown notes with a small local model and stores vectors in a single file. Commenters ask about incremental reindexing and Obsidian integration.

results.title: Hybrid search for docs sites: BM25 + vectors in the client
results.content: Docs search that runs entirely in the browser: BM25 for exact API names, vectors for intent queries. Bundle size and index rebuild time are the trade-offs.

results.title: Retrieval latency is the new cold start (r/LocalLLaMA)
results.content: Discussion of agent pipelines doing 10-30 small retrievals per task; each 50 ms hop compounds. People move to in-memory indexes and accept rebuilding on restart.
